global_prompt: Create one high-fidelity, production-realistic desktop website UI preview for GoaDirectory, shown as a straight-on 16:9 screenshot with no browser chrome, no laptop frame, no presentation board, no surrounding mockup, and no perspective distortion. This is a real local business directory for Goa, India, not a travel-booking site. Use a responsive 12-column layout, crisp spacing, readable interface text, proper alignment, coherent reusable components, semantic visual hierarchy, visible keyboard-focus treatment, and WCAG AA contrast. Render only the requested page and direction. Keep the visual design implementable in WordPress/ClassiPress. Use one clear H1. Do not invent ratings, reviews, prices, opening hours, awards, business counts, user counts, or popularity statistics. Do not use lorem ipsum. Do not display keyword stuffing. Avoid generic AI purple gradients, excessive glassmorphism, random blobs, cartoon icons, identical card grids, and tiny illegible labels. Preserve the exact GoaDirectory brand name and the supplied real business names. Use clean simple line icons where needed. Prioritize an obvious primary task and excellent scanability.

directions.name: Goa Atlas
directions.summary: Cartographic editorial discovery with a strong sense of place.
directions.typography: Manrope for interface, Newsreader for editorial accents
directions.home_prompt: Direction: Goa Atlas. Design a search-first homepage that feels like a beautifully edited local atlas. Use deep estuary teal, laterite coral, warm sand, off-white, and ink. Header: compact GoaDirectory wordmark, Discover, Categories, Guides, For Business, and a coral Post a Listing button. Hero composition is asymmetric: left side has eyebrow 'LOCAL KNOWLEDGE, MADE USEFUL', H1 'Find trusted local businesses across Goa', short line 'Search services, shops and places by category or area', and one large cream search panel with fields 'What are you looking for?', 'Category', 'Area in Goa', plus a coral Search button. Right side is a refined abstract Goa map with subtle rivers, roads, labeled locality chips Vasco, Panaji, Margao, Mapusa, and Ribandar, not a tourist collage. Under the hero show eight compact category tiles for Automobiles, Restaurants, Hotels & Resorts, Beauty & Care, Electronics, Interior & Furniture, General Services, and Tours & Travels. Continue into a visible 'Featured around Goa' editorial row using real names S Nizami Interiors, Mahalaxmi Electric Co, and 13 Studio Unisex Salon. Use fine map-line motifs, generous negative space, no gradients, and strong section numerals.
directions.listing_prompt: Direction: Goa Atlas. Design the Counto Motors listing as a place-rich local business page in the same estuary teal, laterite coral, warm sand, off-white, and ink system. Begin with compact header and breadcrumb 'Home / Automobiles / Counto Motors'. Use exactly one H1: 'Counto Motors Mercedes-Benz Dealership in Ribandar, Goa'. Add an honest status badge 'Listing expired' and category chip 'Automobiles'. Above the fold use a 7/5 split: a large real vehicle gallery with one hero image and two stacked thumbnails on the left; a sticky cream business summary card on the right with location 'Mercedes Benz Showroom, Ribandar, Goa 403006', phone '8308-10-5556', and prominent Call, Directions, Contact Owner buttons plus Save and Share icon actions. Under the gallery show a slim map-coordinate strip and a scannable About section beginning 'Authorized Mercedes-Benz passenger vehicle dealership for Goa' without ratings or invented details. Include a small '13 photos' label and a clear note that address/details should be verified because the listing is expired. Use contour lines and locality-map cues subtly, never behind body text.

directions.home_prompt: Direction: Coastal Signal. Create a bold modern utility homepage using midnight navy, bright aqua, signal orange, sea-foam, and chalk white. Use a dark hero with a very large but controlled H1 'Goa, find what you need nearby.' A bright horizontal search rail crosses the composition with keyword input 'Search businesses or services', segmented area selector 'All Goa', and orange Find it button. Add quick-search text links 'Car rental', 'Electricians', 'Salons', 'Restaurants', 'Hotels'. Build a distinctive modular signal-flag visual system: crisp rectangles, diagonal cuts, coded category markers, never decorative blobs. Below, show a bento-style 'Popular right now' area with varied card sizes, one image-led card for Royal Car & Bike Rental, one typographic card for Mahalaxmi Electric Co, one compact card for A One Flowers, and a mini category index. Header uses white logo, Explore, Areas, Guides, List your business. Add a thin local navigation ticker with Panaji, Vasco, Margao, Mapusa, Ponda, Calangute. Keep it energetic, dense enough to feel useful, and clearly unlike a tourism landing page.
directions.listing_prompt: Direction: Coastal Signal. Create a high-contrast Counto Motors listing page using midnight navy, bright aqua, signal orange, sea-foam, and white. Header and breadcrumb are compact. Use one H1 'Counto Motors Mercedes-Benz Dealership in Ribandar, Goa' on a navy title rail, with orange 'Expired listing' marker and aqua 'Automobiles' marker. Main layout is editorial bento rather than a conventional sidebar: large landscape car photograph occupies the upper left, a Mercedes/Counto identity tile and two gallery thumbnails form the right edge, and a navy action dock sits directly below with Call 8308-10-5556, Directions, Contact Owner, Save. Show 'Mercedes Benz Showroom, Ribandar, Goa 403006' prominently. The next visible band contains 'About Counto Motors', a short verified description, and a compact static map preview with click-to-load message. Use signal-stripe dividers and oversized section numbers 01 Gallery, 02 Details. No rating stars, review score, price, business hours, or fake verification badge.
